files.source:
<?php

array<int> $orders = [120, 80, 40];

int $largest = when ($orders !== []) {
    int $max = 0;
    foreach ($orders as int $amount) {
        if ($amount > $max) {
            $max = $amount;
        }
    }

    return $max;
} else {
    return 0;
};

echo 'Largest order: ' . $largest;
